snippet.title: New Super Mario Bros. Wii: New Horizons | February 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Back this time with a new trailer for my mod NSMBW:NH.
Trailer was featured on Mone's (https://www.youtube.com/@NSMBW-Mone) 2026 direct (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S2FamhZDLyg)

What can I say...since 2023 we've come a long way, and there's still a lot of stuff to work on, so, stay tuned!
